title: Web UI reverse order: view_order_reversed option is unused; reversal is the desc sort
answers: where is view_order_reversed used in the web frontend
why do live flows appear at wrong end in reversed view
how does the flow view sort in mitmweb
body:
- `view_order_reversed` appears only in `web/src/js/ducks/_options_gen.ts` (type + default false); no component/reducer reads it.
- Reversal in the web UI = sort state `{column, desc}` in `ducks/flows/index.ts` (`setSort`, `makeSort`), toggled from `components/FlowTable/FlowTableHead.tsx`.
- `makeSort` returns a comparator using `sortFunctions[column]` from `flow/utils.ts`; with no column it returns `()=>0`.
- **BUG:** `sortFunctions.index` still returns `()=>0` (web/src/js/flow/utils.ts), so under desc every live flow ties and `findInsertPos` (`ducks/flows/_utils.ts`) appends at the end.
- **Proposed fix:** change `sortFunctions.index` to return `flow.timestamp_created` (not yet applied).
- Other columns with ties under desc also append at the end.
applies: mitmweb frontend at this commit; if the option gets wired into the reducer, this changes.

However, the note claims "Fix used: return `flow.timestamp_created`" but this fix has NOT been applied—the code still shows the broken `() => 0` with a comment acknowledging it's broken. The proposed solution is valid but hasn't been implemented yet.
